Mr. Mohammad Ateeque, Advocate for the Petitioner.
Mr. S.B. Bissa, Agp for Respondent Nos.1 & 2/State.

Coram : Raj D. Wakode, J.
Date : 29th December, 2025.
Heard Mr. Mohammad Ateeque, learned counsel for the petitioner.

2. At the outset, Mr. Ateeque, learned counsel for the petitioner, seeks permission of this Court to delete City Survey Nos.714 and 716 from prayer clauses (iii) and (iv) of the present writ petition.
3. Permission is granted.
Aforesaid amendment to be carried out forthwith.
4. Mr. Ateeque, learned counsel for the petitioner, has invited my attention to the order dated 15th May, 2018, passed by this Court in Writ Petition No.2874 of 2018.
In the aforesaid writ petition, this Court had directed the parties to maintain status quo with reference to City Survey No.1031 of Mouza Bhandewadi, on which a graveyard is situated.
The apprehension of the petitioner was that an area admeasuring 230 square meters of City Survey No.1031 was likely to be forcibly cleared of graves and possessed by the respondents.

5. Mr. Ateeque, learned counsel for the petitioner, makes a statement before this Court that Writ Petition No.2874 of 2018 is pending and that the interim order dated 15th May, 2018, which was continued until further orders by this Court vide order dated 22nd May, 2018, continues to operate till date.

In this backdrop, he has invited my attention to paragraph 18 of the present writ petition,
which reads thus:
18.
The petitioner further says and submit that since last 2-3 days the respondent No.4 has started its construction activities upon City Survey No.1031, which is a Waqf Sau.

sentences.text: A copy of photographs showing the construction work going on at City S. No.1031 is annexed herewith and marked as ANNEXURE-16.
The petitioner has also submitted representations/request letters to the respondent authorities and pointed out the orders passed by this Hon'ble Court time to time.

Copies of representations/request letters are collectively annexed herewith and marked as ANNEXURE-17."
6.
In view of the above, issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 12th January, 2026.

7. Mr. S.B. Bissa, learned AGP, waives service of notice on behalf of respondent Nos.1 and 2.
8.
In addition to the usual mode, the petitioner to serve the remaining respondents by private mode.

9. In view of the interim order passed by this Court on 15th May, 2018, in Writ Petition No.2874 of 2018, pertaining to City Survey No.1031 of Mouza Bhandewadi, which continues to operate till date,
the parties are directed to comply with the said order of status quo till the returnable date.
